breakingNews.title: Breaking News: Hurricane Melissa hits Jamaica
breakingNews.summary: Jamaican Prime Minister Andrew Holness declared the country a disaster area on Tuesday.

breakingNews.title: Breaking News: New US attack on Venezuela
breakingNews.summary: 14 dead in new US attack on Venezuela, according to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

breakingNews.title: Breaking News: Dodgers take lead in the World Series
breakingNews.summary: After 18 innings against the Blue Jays, the Dodgers take the lead in the World Series.

world.title: Escalating armed conflict is most urgent threat for world in 2025, say global leaders
world.summary: Global leaders have identified escalating armed conflict as the most immediate threat in 2025, with the ongoing war in Ukraine and violent conflicts in Sudan and Gaza being major concerns.

world.title: China and Russia sign pipeline deal through Mongolia
world.summary: China and Russia sign a major energy deal to build a new gas pipeline through Mongolia, deepening their strategic and economic ties.

world.title: 17th BRICS Leaders Summit opens in Rio de Janeiro focusing on global-south cooperation
world.summary: The 17th BRICS Summit under theme “Strengthening Global South Cooperation and Promoting a More Inclusive and Sustainable Global Governance”.

technology.title: Amazon cuts 14,000 corporate jobs as spending on AI accelerates
technology.summary: Amazon will cut about 14,000 corporate jobs as the online retail giant ramps up spending on artificial intelligence.

technology.title: EU finds Meta and TikTok in breach of transparency rules
technology.summary: The European Commission announced preliminary findings that Meta and TikTok violated key provisions of the Digital Services Act, including lack of transparency around algorithms.

technology.title: Executive Order shifts U.S. AI policy to pro-innovation agenda
technology.summary: The U.S. Executive Order 14179 revokes parts of previous AI policy and initiates a new AI action plan focusing on competitiveness over regulation.

sports.title: 2025 FIFA Club World Cup broadcasting rights awarded to DAZN
sports.summary: DAZN secured global rights to the 2025 FIFA Club World Cup, streaming all matches and reshaping sports media distribution.

sports.title: Rivalries reignite in Madrid and London, while Ohtani eyes World Series glory
sports.summary: Real Madrid vs Barcelona returns in LaLiga, England and Australia revive the Ashes series, and Shohei Ohtani leads the Dodgers into the World Series aiming for back-to-back titles.

sports.title: MLB sponsorship revenue up 9% to US$2.05bn in 2025
sports.summary: Major League Baseball becomes the second North American sports competition to exceed US$2 billion in team sponsorship revenue, up 9% year-over-year.
